posts.text: Excited to share that I’ve started a new position at Scotia Wealth Management as a Scotia McLeod Intern on the Business & Strategic Initiatives team! I’m looking forward to learning more about wealth management, strategy, and the financial services industry while working alongside such a talented team. Grateful to Shabreen Ahmed, PMP, CMP, Prosci and Raseld Dedej for offering this opportunity and excited for what’s ahead this summer. Thank you to Obiageli (Oby) Nwaoshai and Alyshah Mamdani-Pradh

Grateful to have attended an incredible Velocity Internship Program Development Day hosted by Olivia Ngo and Neve Molly Ryan at the CN Tower 🌇 as part of my summer internship at Scotiabank. The day was packed with insights and inspiration—from an amazing discussion on true confidence vs false confidence by Alex Cardoso to workshops focused on uncovering our strengths and growing as professionals.
